scope: Runner-only opt-in for existing RomFS instrumentation. No C/backend/builder, filesystem adapter, asset, game behavior or asynchronous callback change.
reason: Root observed repeated native loading-screen presentation without new fatal IPC. A bounded read-only adapter review found no proven active audio/movie/async success-stub cause. The next actual measurement needs file-open and read-activity evidence instead of a speculative bypass.

option.name: --trace-files
option.direct_API: getattr default false preserves old Namespace callers. Require type(value) is bool and validate before work/path IO; bool-like integers and strings are invalid.
option.CLI: argparse store_true, independently checked through the same helper; explicit value forms such as --trace-files=1 are rejected.
option.disabled_child_environment: Both keys are absent, not set to zero, because the existing C implementation tests getenv presence. Hostile parent values are not inherited.
option.boundary: No arbitrary environment input, SVC trace, GPU flag, global setting or persistent configuration is added. This only adds the two fixed known keys to the existing explicit child environment when requested.

existing_instrumentation.runtime/romfs.c:fs_log: Logs RomFS open/miss and existing runtime_fs_log operations with relative time when CASTLEVANIA_FS_LOG is present.
existing_instrumentation.runtime/romfs.c:runtime_romfs_read: When CASTLEVANIA_FS_TIMING is present, counts real completed reads/bytes and aggregate wall/prepare timings; periodically reports a read window. It does not add a callback, simulated completion, fabricated file or permissions.
existing_instrumentation.no_runtime_edit: These existing instrumentation implementations were read only. Their successful IO, error and hash behavior remain unchanged.

receipt_and_privacy.file_trace_requested: Validated explicit opt-in, not evidence that a particular game asset was requested.
receipt_and_privacy.file_trace_flags_applied_to_child: True only when both fixed keys are sent to this child.
receipt_and_privacy.file_trace_log_scope: Existing owned mode0600 native-host.log inside the mode0700 private run/logs directory.
receipt_and_privacy.raw_paths: Raw game virtual paths remain in the private existing log. No separate public trace or filename list is created. The existing diagnostic_tail filter may also retain error lines containing paths in the private mode0600 receipt; this change does not promise all paths can never appear there.
receipt_and_privacy.unchanged: Scratch marker/token/cwd, source/build and RomFS bindings, app packaging, limits, timeout, cleanup, GPU opt-in and profile/save isolation remain in force. No trace payload from an actual game run is embedded in this source provenance.
